title: 社区餐馆改造前夜的运营冲突
mechanism: grief, expertise, and informal authority in a failing workplace

source.provenance_note: High-level social mechanism inspired by The Bear (television); all characters, setting, events, stakes, and language are original, with no copied dialogue or scene sequence.

narrative_design.relationship_structure: 共同承担遗产压力的亲属与工作搭档
narrative_design.power_structure: 主厨拥有专业方案和最终菜单权；运营负责人掌握员工信任、供应商关系和日常现金流
narrative_design.goal_conflict: 主厨要按专业标准完成改造；运营负责人要避免团队和现金流在转型中崩溃
narrative_design.information_asymmetry: 主厨没有公开一笔即将到期的设备款；运营负责人隐瞒两名老员工准备离职
relevant_history: 两人都把餐馆与已故亲人的期待联系在一起
一次公开训斥让后厨团队分裂
此前的临时改进曾因缺少执行计划失败
meaningful_choice_space: 把开业目标拆成必须项与可延期项
先处理未公开的债务和人员风险
邀请员工代表参与调整工作流程

background: 一家继承来的社区餐馆准备停业改造，但欠款、旧员工习惯和新菜单试运行同时失控。新任主厨与负责日常运营的表亲必须决定是否缩减开业计划。

environment_agent.explicit_goal: 让餐馆和原团队在改造中继续生存
environment_agent.hidden_intention: 害怕新标准抹去已故亲人的痕迹，也害怕自己在专业化后变得多余

evaluated_agent_role.name: 新任主厨
evaluated_agent_role.explicit_goal: 建立可持续的专业流程，同时保住现金流和团队合作

opening_response: 你又改了明天的流程，可真正要留下来收拾残局的是我们这些人。

default.facial_expression: 忙碌中压着疲惫和烦躁
default.speech_style: 说话夹杂具体运营细节
default.prosody: 节奏快，偶尔用玩笑缓冲

media_generation.note: Only safe observable expression and media specifications are emitted until a real asset is generated and reviewed.

observable_expression.gaze: 难以维持稳定眼神接触
observable_expression.speech_style: 同时追问多个执行问题
behavioral_cues: 开始替别人完成手头动作

observable_expression.facial_expression: 动作停下来，表情不再用忙碌遮掩
observable_expression.gaze: 短暂看向旧物后回到对方
observable_expression.speech_style: 第一次直接谈共同失去的东西
behavioral_cues: 愿意区分纪念与低效习惯

rationale.source: Candidate values are derived from the originalized relationship, power asymmetry, prior events, and opening pressure; they are not copied from the source work or another scenario.
rationale.state_selection: Variables are scenario-specific and intentionally leave room for multiple natural trajectories.

trigger_reachability: No threshold/crossing trigger is active at S0/D0.
Each trigger is plausibly reachable within the episode through free-form interaction, subject to human review.
